local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frames=0
local droppedElapsed=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if not core.isWorldPaused() and Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x0243fc))==0 then droppedElapsed=droppedElapsed+dt end
 if droppedElapsed>=3 then print('SkillBookDrop three simulation seconds after full-stack drop') end
 frames=frames+1;if frames<60 or frames%15~=0 then return end
 for _,obj in ipairs(Actor.inventory(self):getAll()) do if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x0243fc) then local rec=types.Book.record(obj);assert(rec.name=='Immortal Blood' and rec.weight==1 and rec.value==25,'Original ImmortalBlood properties changed');print('SkillBookDrop original properties value=25 weight=1') end end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died testing genuine ImmortalBlood drop')
 print('SkillBookDrop stock='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x0243fc))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' nirnroot='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4e940))..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
 for _,o in ipairs(nearby.items) do
  if tostring(o.recordId)==tostring(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x0243fc)) then assert(not types.Book.objectIsInstance(o),'ImmortalBlood world drop must have native identity');print('SkillBookDrop nearby id='..o.id..' base='..tostring(o.recordId)..' position='..tostring(o.position)) end
 end
end}}}}
